cases.name: prepared_scalar
cases.tql: FIND {kind: "alpha"} AS seed WITH seed RETURN seed, $bonus + 1 AS score

cases.name: path_value
cases.tql: SEARCH VECTOR [1, 0] TOP 1 AS seed WITH seed SHORTEST_PATHS seed TO [2] LABEL next AS route WITH route RETURN path(route) AS path

cases.name: prepared_missing_parameter
cases.tql: FIND {kind: "alpha"} AS seed WITH seed RETURN seed, $required AS value

before_delete.query: TEXT BM25 "oldtoken" TOP 10 AS hits WITH hits RETURN hits
TEXT BM25 "newtoken" TOP 10 AS hits WITH hits RETURN hits
TEXT AC "personanchor" TOP 10 AS hits WITH hits RETURN hits
